question.html:
The graph shows the variation with the potential difference V of the current in an ohmic resistor P and a non-ohmic component Q.

a Calculate the resistance of P. [1]

b Outline how the resistance of Q changes when the current in it increases. [1]

c State, in mA, the reading of the ammeter. [1]

d Determine the emf of the cell. [2]
